title: Networked Players
description: Given two artists or releases, Networked Players finds a documented path through credited work and shows the evidence for every step.

hero.headline: Explore the hidden network behind recorded music.
hero.lede: Every album, contributor, and connection here is real, sourced, and versioned. Play today's connection, guess who links two records, or step straight into the credit graph — the evidence for every hop is one click away.

focus.heading: Every connection carries its evidence.
focus.lede: An edge between two artists means they are documented performing on the same recording or release. The path keeps that proof attached at every hop, with provenance back to the source.

cards.title: Documented credits only
cards.body: A documented performance credit means two artists are credited as performing on the same recording or release — nothing about how they got along.

cards.title: Sourced and versioned
cards.body: Publishable facts derive from CC0 Discogs monthly dumps, carried with snapshot date, source, parser and schema versions, and original role text.

cards.title: Works with no backend
cards.body: The experience loads a small, versioned static artifact and runs entirely in your browser. No live API is required for the core experience.
